name: Tideglass Dragon - Young
description: Young Tideglass is a good-leaning covenant intelligent true dragon with translucent sea-glass scales containing remembered faces. It seeks to preserve endangered memories. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Glass Fangs
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Waterborne
abilities.description: The dragon moves through water and flooded ground without impediment and can breathe underwater.

abilities.name: Remembrance Tide
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and the target relives a stored memory and is Vulnerable until its next action. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
